This version is presented with a female solo lead in a polished, coherent full-mix production that builds toward the bridge and final chorus. The song is not gender-bound and is open to alternative lead-performer and production treatments; its repeated sectional structure also provides bounded edit and shortening potential while preserving the central title hook and message.
